help.title: How cospace works
help.intro: cospace connects owners of underused spaces with people who need them — directly, without intermediaries.
help.step1Body: Discover available spaces on the interactive map or switch to list view. Each pin is a real space in the neighbourhood.
help.step2Body: Select the type of space you need: storage, studio, outdoor or room. Sort by proximity, price or rating.
help.step3Body: Click on any space to see photos, amenities, price and direct contact details for the owner.
help.step4Body: Have an unused unit, courtyard or room? Publish it in under 5 minutes and start receiving direct contacts.
help.mobileDesc: Tap any pin to see the space. Use the floating button to switch between map and list view.
help.desktopDesc: The space list appears on the right. On the left, the map updates in real time as you browse.
